source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check Mini DP can work with resolution change
1.Power on SUT and boot into OS.
2.Change the current video resolution and color depth to better.
3.Choose the "Test" button to test the changes, then choose "Apply" to accept the changes.
4.Shutdown and restart the OS, then login.
5.Review Event Viewer logs to confirm there are no errors or fault conditions reported.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1.All selectable changes up to 4096 x 2160 at a 16bit color depth should function properly. Higher resolutions may not work properly because of limitations of the video driver used and the supported resolutions of the monitor used.
2.Screen can display w/o error.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Resolution change up - 4096 x 2160 x 16bit: change the Mini-DP video resolution/color depth up to 4096x2160@16bit in the OS display settings. Requires a person at the display + OS desktop GUI (Test -> Apply); agent can read the current mode with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "xrandr 2>&1 | grep -iE 'connected|\*' | head 2>&1" if a GUI session is present, but the GUI change + visual confirmation are operator/visual.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the xrandr/DRM mode list so the user confirms 4096x2160@16bit applied properly on the Mini-DP display; the GUI apply + visual check are operator.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: resolution change is a GUI/visual check on the Mini-DP display - operator performs it; agent only reads the OS mode.

original_test_intent: Verify all approved selectable MiniDP modes through 4096x2160 at the source-defined 16-bit colour depth, including a visible error-free image, persistence through restart/login and clean display/driver logs.
original_method: An engineer uses OS GUI Test/Apply across the approved DCI-4K-and-lower matrix, visually inspects the physical display, restarts and logs in, then reviews Event Viewer and supporting logs.
manual_activity: The engineer must execute GUI Test/Apply and visually judge image presence, stability, scaling and artifacts for every approved mode through 4096x2160, then confirm restart/login recovery.
required_inputs: GPU/driver, MiniDP link/cable and monitor/EDID supporting the exact 4096x2160 timing
16-bit colour, refresh and all-selectable mode matrix
Maintenance approval, physical display operator, known-good revert mode and alternate console
safety_requirements: Do not infer support for 4096x2160 from 3840x2160 capability.
Do not apply an unadvertised timing/depth and keep independent KVM/console recovery.
Treat mode change and restart as service-impacting; preserve Event Viewer/system logs.
Stop on blank output, incorrect scaling, artifacts, driver reset or failed login; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect OS-native EDID, link, mode/depth, GPU/driver and event data around each approved change.
Track distinct 4096x2160 timing coverage and restart state.
Compare electronic/log evidence while leaving physical image acceptance and verdict to the engineer.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact 4096x2160 timing/depth/refresh matrix and recovery.
Perform GUI Test/Apply, visually inspect all required modes and restart/login.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not sufficient or portable. xrandr is Linux-specific while Event Viewer implies Windows, and a read-only current-mode line cannot prove the GUI action, depth, distinct 4096 timing, image quality or persistence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use documented OS-native read-only EDID/timing/mode and event collection only after platform identification; do not automate the highest mode without a tested recovery path.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All selectable modes through 4096x2160, 16-bit colour, Test/Apply, restart/login, Event Viewer and 10/5-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: PLATFORM METHOD PENDING; RETAIN HUMAN HIGHEST-MODE CORE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Confirm that EDID and the complete link advertise the exact 4096x2160 timing, capture timing/depth after each GUI application, photograph a diagnostic pattern for scaling/artifacts, restart at the final approved mode and export display/driver events.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact OS, GPU/driver, MiniDP link and 4096-capable display.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record OS build, GPU firmware/driver and monitor EDID.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner display specification and OS/GPU/monitor timing documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact DCI-versus-UHD timing identity and per-mode traceability without replacing human observation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No lower mode is removed and 3840x2160 success is not substituted for 4096x2160.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Exact timing, link capability and mode matrix.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A reported resolution can hide scaling, cropping, reduced refresh or chroma changes unless separately specified.

project_override_considerations: The project may define refresh, timing and accepted colour encoding. A reduced matrix is completion only for that approved plan. Missing parameters affect readiness, not permanent BLOCKED.
expected_evidence: Per-mode GUI, electronic timing/depth and visual evidence through 4096x2160
Successful restart/login with final approved mode
Event Viewer/system/BMC/SEL review, restoration and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The highest-resolution, visual, restart and log requirements are consistent; refresh/timing/depth specifics are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The method is clear. Platform capability and exact timing determine readiness but do not permanently block the case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Reject PARTIAL and Linux readback as full coverage; retain it only conditionally as supporting telemetry.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retain its highest-mode capability and recovery analysis while applying MANUAL ONLY to the GUI/visual core.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Explicitly distinguishes 4096x2160 from UHD and preserves lower-mode coverage.

review_improvement: Prevents 3840-class or current-mode evidence from being overstated as successful 4096x2160 image, colour, persistence and log coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source accepts physical screen quality after a GUI operation and restart. Mode telemetry cannot establish those human-visible properties, so the core classification is MANUAL ONLY.
